name: [UPDATE] DUELIST: PvP
desc:
Duelist: PvP

Duelist: PvP lets you showcase your third-person combat skills in fast-paced battles. Choose your weapon, step into the arena, and prove yourself against other players.
The game also features over 100 unlockable cosmetics, including weapon skins, kill effects (KFX), graffiti, backpacks, and accessories, with some rarer than others.

🌐Game supports: PC, MOBILE, CONSOLE
🚨 Keybinds and Sens can be customized in the settings!


🎯Game Modes:
• 1v1
• 2v2
• 3v3
• FFA

⚠️ This game is currently in beta. Expect changes!
⚠️ Exploiting or cheating will result in a permanent ban. We do not appeal bans.
⚠️If you encounter any glitch, please let us know, and we will fix them as soon as possible!
